# View project history and status `VPH`

[As built](../README.md) › View project history and status

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Lets a user see a project's event history, status overview and ledger logs, and shows the project status bar and tabs used throughout the console, built from export:project_history and export:summary.
